mapper.sql: WHERE q.bank_id IN #{id}q.bank_id=#{scope.questionBankId} AND NOT q.is_group AND q.id IN #{id} AND q.chapter_id IN #{id} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_favorite f WHERE f.user_id=#{userId} AND f.question_id=q.id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM self_factsfacts f WHERE f.question_id=q.id AND f.rn=1 AND f.self_assessmentf.judgment='WRONG') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM totals t WHERE t.question_id=q.id AND t.wrong_count>0) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM totals t WHERE t.question_id=q.id AND t.wrong_count >= 2) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facts f WHERE f.question_id=q.id AND f.rn=1 AND f.submitted_at >= now()-interval '7 days') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM practice_item i JOIN practice_session ps ON ps.id=i.session_id WHERE i.question_id=q.id AND ps.user_id=#{userId} AND (ps.status='SUBMITTED' OR (ps.feedback='IMMEDIATE' AND i.confirmed AND i.outcome IN ('CORRECT','WRONG'))) AND i.outcome IN ('CORRECT','WRONG','SELF_RATED'))
